metaTitle: Find Skin Essence | 21st Floor, Kalyani Nagar, Pune
metaDescription: Skin Essence is on the 21st floor of Brahma Business Park, Tower T9, New Kalyani Nagar, Pune. Directions, floor guide and contact details.
landmark: Near F Residence, New Kalyani Nagar
mapsNote: Google Maps brings you to the building. From there, the clinic is on the 21st floor of Tower T9.

steps.title: Reach the building
steps.description: Come to Brahma Business Park, Tower T9, near F Residence in New Kalyani Nagar.

steps.title: Walk to the lifts
steps.description: Enter the lobby of Tower T9 and head to the lift area.

steps.title: Take the lift to the 21st floor
steps.description: Press 21. This is the part Google Maps cannot tell you.

steps.title: Find the clinic
steps.description: Step out and follow the Skin Essence signage to Office No. 2107, 2108 and 2109.

help.title: Can't find us?
help.description: Call or WhatsApp the clinic and the team will guide you in. You can also book your consultation on the same number.

whatsappMessage: Hi, I'm on my way to Skin Essence at Brahma Business Park. Could you help me find the clinic?
